system.description: In a combination of leading the attack, fooling her attacker and quickly dodging out of the way, the Lunar redirects an attack on her person toward someone else. The Lunar must be aware of the attack, which must have another valid target within (Dexterity) yards of the attack. The Lunar's player rolls (Dexterity + Athletics) at a difficulty of the attacker's Perception. Success indicates that she redirects that attack, with all of its successes and effects, at another valid target of her choice. That attack then plays out as normal.
